buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Participating bidders should have a service centre in Tamil Nadu. If the bidder does not submit proof of ha ving a service centre in Tamil Nadu, they will be disqualified. The safe offered should be a Class BB Jewel Safe, TRTL-15x6 with 7 shelves and 16 jewel trays. The dimens ions and specifications must comply with IS 550 (Part I): 2014. The OEM should have a minimum of 5 years' experience as on 31.03.2025 in the supply of TRTL safes. The OEM must submit financial statements for the last three financial years: The safe must carry an IS 550 listing mark as per BIS rules for TRTL-15x6 rating. The BIS labelling mu st cl early indicates the manufacturer or brand name, class and rating of the product, year of manufacture, IS n umber, and CML number allotted by BIS. The safes required will be Class BB 1340 Single Door as per IS 550 (Part-I):2014. The vendor must be the OEM for locks and must possess valid IS 17566 certifications. Only authorized dealers of Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) are eligible. An authorization letter m

ust be submitted on the OEM’s letterhead. The OEM must hold a valid BIS license for all physical security equipment mentioned in the tender. If the B IS license for any applied product category expires before the process is completed, a renewed license mu st be submitted. Failure to do so will result in disqualification. The safe offered should have a minimum weight of 1600 kg. The OEM and/or authorized agent must give written consent to the Bank for random testing of the product at their own cost at a BIS-approved laboratory. They must also agree to replace the product to be tested w ith a new product of the same class before testing. All transportation and testing costs will be borne by the OEM/authorized agent. This requirement will be at the exclusive discretion of the Bank. Only experience with PSU Banks or Scheduled Commercial Banks will be considered. A copy of the purchas e order along with the purchaser’s contact details must be attached for verification. The vendor must provide a valid ISO certification. The OEM must provide a declaration on its company letterhead stating that it has not been blacklisted or d ebarred in the last 3 years by any Government Department, Financial Institution, Public Sector Unit, or Sch eduled Commercial Bank in India. Only Empanelled vendors of Bank of Baroda are eligible to participate in this tender .
